evidence_quotes.name_asked: Can you give me your first and last name, please?
evidence_quotes.name_used: Name was collected but never used again in the call.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This should take me about ten to fifteen minutes and then I'd be able to get you a quote. Sounds good. — time-boxed but no dependable-quote promise; also no wait for yes before moving on.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. The rep moved directly into logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.packing_asked: We also offer packing services. We just charge for the materials. — packing offered but no box-count question.
evidence_quotes.two_promises: Neither On-Time Guarantee nor No Worries Damage Coverage mentioned at any point.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: What we can do is, we can do a video call, like a virtual walkthrough, so that we can see everything that we're going to be packing and moving. Is that something you're interested in? — Clean routing to virtual walkthrough; confirmed 4:00 PM today with text link sent.

top_strength: Jules correctly identified the move as a large one (6,200 sq ft, two-story) and cleanly routed to a virtual walkthrough with confirmed next steps and a specific time, rather than attempting to quote over the phone.
coaching_note: Before routing to the walkthrough, Jules must ask the Two Concerns question (on-time delivery and damage) and deliver both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) — these come in step 3, before probing, and belong on every call including walkthroughs.
